creatures.name: Gloomfox
creatures.description: A small fox with hollow eyes that drift between dimensions. Loves rainy days and quiet voids.

creatures.name: Sparkitty
creatures.description: A cat-shaped static discharge that purrs in kilovolts. Extremely unpredictable.

creatures.name: Mossling
creatures.description: A round creature entirely covered in soft moss. Smells like petrichor.

creatures.name: Blobette
creatures.description: A transparent blob with no discernible features. Exists. That's it.

creatures.name: Cinderpup
creatures.description: A puppy made of smoldering ash. Wags its tail and sets things on fire accidentally.

creatures.name: Driftling
creatures.description: A wispy ghost-like creature that floats wherever the breeze takes it. Often lost.

creatures.name: Neonmoth
creatures.description: A moth that glows with neon UV light. Intensely drawn to screens and lanterns.

creatures.name: Crystalsnail
creatures.description: A snail whose shell is made of raw amethyst. Carries the weight of the world slowly.

creatures.name: Frostveil
creatures.description: A creature wrapped in perpetual frost. Breathes snowflakes. Very quiet.

creatures.name: Plaguerat
creatures.description: A rat wearing a tiny plague doctor mask. Knows too much and says nothing.

creatures.name: Tidewyrm
creatures.description: A small sea serpent that coils around kelp forests. Hums at 432hz.

creatures.name: Lunarfawn
creatures.description: A deer made entirely of moonlight. Only appears on foggy nights.

creatures.name: Voidcrab
creatures.description: A crustacean from the space between spaces. Aggressively unimpressed by everything.

creatures.name: Emberstag
creatures.description: A stag whose antlers burn eternally. Leaves scorched hoof prints.

creatures.name: Silkwraith
creatures.description: A wraith wrapped in threads of silk shadow. Watches. Always watches.

creatures.name: Prismhawk
creatures.description: A hawk with wings that refract sunlight into catastrophic rainbows. Untamable.

creatures.name: Nullbear
creatures.description: A bear-shaped hole in reality. Cannot be photographed. Doesn't care.

creatures.name: Stormjelly
creatures.description: A jellyfish that floats through thunderclouds. Each sting conducts lightning.

creatures.name: Fernclaw
creatures.description: A creature with claws made of ancient fern. Slow to anger, devastating when provoked.

creatures.name: Ashphoenix
creatures.description: A phoenix that refuses to reborn in flames. Rises from spreadsheets instead.

creatures.name: Cosmoscat
creatures.description: A cat made of compressed starlight. Knocks galaxies off shelves for fun.

creatures.name: Abyssleviathan
creatures.description: A whale-sized entity from the deepest ocean trench. Sings songs no one remembers.

creatures.name: Chronowolf
creatures.description: A wolf that exists simultaneously in every second of history. Its howl is a paradox.

creatures.name: Ruinsdrake
creatures.description: A dragon born from crumbled civilizations. Has seen it all. Mildly disappointed.

creatures.name: Glitchsprite
creatures.description: A sprite born from corrupted code. Exists in 8-bit and 4K simultaneously.

creatures.name: Voidmatriarch
creatures.description: The mother of all voids. She doesn't hunt. She waits. She always wins.

creatures.name: Solarlion
creatures.description: A lion whose mane is a captured sun. One roar vaporizes clouds for 100 miles.

creatures.name: Nightweaver
creatures.description: An entity that stitches night sky together each dusk. Cries constellations.

creatures.name: Echogolem
creatures.description: A golem made of crystallized sound waves. Vibrates at the frequency of forgotten music.

creatures.name: Mirecrawler
creatures.description: A slow-moving creature of deep bog mud. Leaves trails of sad little footprints.

creatures.name: Hazebird
creatures.description: A dove wrapped in morning haze. Appears in doorways and disappears before you blink.

creatures.name: Bloomwitch
creatures.description: A witch who blooms seasonally. Gives unsolicited life advice in petal form.

creatures.name: Ironspectre
creatures.description: A ghost made of rust and old metal. Haunts abandoned factories with passive aggression.

creatures.name: Pixiedust
creatures.description: A cloud of sentient glitter with opinions. Very chaotic. Very sparkly.

creatures.name: Rimeowl
creatures.description: An owl whose feathers are frozen icicles. Hoots in Morse code at exactly midnight.

creatures.name: Thornhog
creatures.description: A hedgehog with thorns instead of quills. Extremely defensive in every sense of the word.
